theorems.statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (Φ : Eucl n → Eucl P) (Ω : Set (Eucl n)) (B : Set (Eucl n)) (χ : Eucl n → Eucl n) (S : Set (Eucl n)) (ψ : Eucl P → ℝ≥0∞), IsOpen Ω → (∃ K : ℝ≥0, LipschitzOnWith K Φ Ω) → (∃ c : ℝ, 0 < c ∧ ∀ w ∈ Ω, ∀ w' ∈ Ω, c * ‖w - w'‖ ≤ ‖Φ w - Φ w'‖) → IsOpen B → ContDiffOn ℝ 1 χ B → InjOn χ B → χ '' B ⊆ Ω → MeasurableSet S → S ⊆ χ '' B → Measurable ψ → ∫⁻ x in Φ '' S, ψ x ∂(μHE[n] : Measure (Eucl P)) = ∫⁻ y, (B ∩ χ ⁻¹' S).indicator (fun y => ENNReal.ofReal |(fderiv ℝ χ y).det| * (ψ (Φ (χ y)) * ENNReal.ofReal (Real.sqrt (Matrix.of fun i j => inner ℝ (fderiv ℝ Φ (χ y) (EuclideanSpace.single i 1)) (fderiv ℝ Φ (χ y) (EuclideanSpace.single j 1))).det))) y ∂(volume : Measure (Eucl n))
